entities.summary: Josef Pfitzner was a politician of Nazi Germany and a writer. He held the rank of SA-Standartenführer in the Sturmabteilung (SA). Pfitzner was publicly executed in Prague after World War II for speaking in favour of the Nazis, taking part in Nazi organisations, and defrauding the city of Prague in financial deals with the Germans.
